# v1.2 Scientific Changelog

## Added

- Finite-horizon commutant-projection certificate with explicit dependence on the smallest eigenvalue-group separation.
- Near-degenerate four-dimensional control showing that two-scale and commutator residuals can be small before the exact projection is reached.
- End-to-end store-information operator and a store-budget proposition.
- Eight-draw comparison between write-block and store-optimized directions.
- Exact post-write Fisher-matrix invariance theorem.
- Approximate-isolation lower bound `J_h >= J_0/(1+alpha_h)`.
- Eight-draw, 5,000-trial-per-draw sampled GLS decoder experiment.
- Shi–Rojas black-box Fisher-information-rate estimator in related work as a complementary, distinct object.

## Corrected

- Kerg et al. are no longer characterized as having a wholly non-bi-power-bounded parameterization.
- “Two independent dials” is replaced by separate roles with possible magnitude cross-effects.
- The original oracle is disclosed as a direction selected from the conditioned write block and shared across paired cells.
- Figure 3 now labels the actually plotted forward finite-window gain.
- Exact Fisher invariance is explicitly separated from fixed-decoder, quantized, clipped and finite-precision retrieval.

## Removed from public candidate

- Superseded one-page summary.
- Internal handoffs, governance records and unrelated mirror metadata.
- Superseded result interpretations.
